newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: ANZ Bank pares NZ fixed mtg rate, reviews variable.
newsitem.headline: ANZ Bank pares NZ fixed mtg rate, reviews variable.

text.p: ANZ Bank and its affiliate Postbank said on Friday they would be cutting their current one-year fixed mortgage rate in New Zealand to 9.25 percent from 9.40 percent.
In a statement explaining that the move followed recent falls in wholesale money market rates, ANZ said it had put under review its 9.95 percent variable mortgage rate.
A number of New Zealand banks have cut their variable and fixed mortgage rates in recent days folowing Tuesday's lower-than-expected consumer price index rise for the March quarter.
